Yes — as a US passport holder you do need a visa for Vietnam. The US does not have a visa-free (or bilateral/unilateral exemption) arrangement with Vietnam, so you can't just show up without one.

The easiest option is Vietnam's e-Visa:
- Valid for stays of up to 90 days, so your 2-week trip is well covered
- Cost: USD 25 for single-entry, USD 50 for multiple-entry
- Processing typically takes 2-3 business days (expedited options are available for a higher fee)
- Apply online at the official portal: https://evisa.gov.vn/
- Usable for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports

A couple of things to keep in mind:
- Your passport needs to be valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.
- This policy data is current as of 2026-08-17 — I'd recommend double-checking the live requirements at evisa.gov.vn before you travel, just to be safe.
